title: Fancy Tab Sections
description: A library to allow for easy control of Sections inside Creative Mode Tabs
body:
A lightweight library allowing for easy customization of Creative Mode Tabs using Sections, with **no extra downloads** needed!

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1537163/description_b2a13760-ec1a-4355-9bb5-d359f6756a60.webp)

Using the library is extremely simple, using a single method you too can have a fancy new Section!

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1537163/description_ad86d9ba-953d-425a-b6a6-ac104cf0053f.png)


Documentation on how to use this API is available at [https://github.com/MC-Expanded/Fancy-Tabs-Neo/wiki](https://github.com/MC-Expanded/Fancy-Tabs-Neo/wiki)

Fancy Tab Sections is designed to be Jar-in-Jar'd, meaning users won't have to download it separately when using your mod.

Inspired by Create Aeronautics!

- made by wd with lots of love
